outline: This course provides the students an insight into structural analysis. Some essential classical analysis methods are described. The purpose of this course is to make the students a better understanding of analytical principles of structures. The practical applications to structural engineering are also discussed.
schedule:
Week 1：Introduction
Week 2：Background of Structural Analysis
Week 3：Justification of Stability Degree of Structure I
Week 4：Justification of Stability Degree of Structure II
Week 5：Analysis of Reactions of Statically Determinate Structure
Week 6：Analysis of Shear Force & Bending Moment of Statically Determinate Beam
Week 7：Analysis of Axial Force, Shear Force & Bending Moment of Statically Determinate Rigid Frame
Week 8：Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss I
Week 9：Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss II
Week 10：Analysis of Axial Force of Statically Determinate Truss III
Week 11：Midterm
Week 12：Virtual Work Theory
Week 13：Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Beam & Rigid Frame
Week 14：Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Truss I
Week 15：Analysis of Influence Line of Statically Determinate Truss II
Week 16：Conjugate Beam Method I
Week 17：Conjugate Beam Method II
Week 18：Final
